description.value: A ruin gate in Sunstone Valley with the interaction header "Precursor Ruins" and "Press X or mouse". The Sunstone Valley region panel lists "Precursor Ruins" with The Rumbledome, Sandscale Oasis, Red's Haven, Whirly's Scrap Camp, Rough Rider Raceway, Sunstone Valley Approach and Glimmerdeep Hydropower Dam. The Dig is northeast of the ruins (wiki), and a Gateway quest sends the player "to the nearby Precursor Ruins" (loc 1137255156, 696992562). | [video G2tF5uF5cBE/01452, b6QfVC_2YpQ/00028] [wiki: The Dig] [client]
